question: What is the name of India's first privately developed fully cryogenic rocket engine ?
solution:
The correct answer is** Dhawan-1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhawan-1** is the** country's first privately developed completely cryogenic rocket engine.**
 
• It is created by a** Hyderabad-based startup **in space technology.
 
• **Satish Dhawan**, an Indian rocket scientist, is honoured by the name.
 
• It is created utilising **3D printing technology **and runs on liquid oxygen and liquefied natural gas as fuel.
 
• It is entirely produced in **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Homi Bhabha**

 
 
• He is credited with founding **India's nuclear programme.**
 
• Founding director of the **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre,** formerly known as the **Atomic Energy Establishment**.
 
• He received** Padma Bhushan and Adam's** prizes.
 
 
 
• **Dr Vikram Ambalal Sarabhai**
 
 
• Father of the **Indian Space Program**.
 
• Established a **Physical Research Laboratory in Ahmedabad.**
 
• **Chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission.**
 
 
 
• **Dr APJ Abdul Kalam**
 
 
• The Missile Man of India.
 
• Entitled as the 11th president of India.
 
 
 
• **Satish Dhawan****​**
 
 
• He was both a **mathematician** and an** aerospace engineer.**
 
• He served as** ISRO's third chairman.**
 
• He received numerous honours, including the **Padma Vibhushan and the Padma Bhushan.**
